system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Prompt:Question: What is the meaning of {entity_name}? Context: {context} Extra Information: {extra_information}

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: natural language-based content information, such as the entity’s syntactic, lexical, and semantic information, is vectorised via a text embedding model and then stored in the vector database to enable similarity search

context_compaction.evidence_quote: We use a conversational dialogue to store the original intermediate output of each operating process, with no map-reduce applied.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the outputs are short sentences that are easier for LLMs to interpret

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We select the tool calling agent (a.k.a. function calling agent).
tool_call_format.note: For open-source LLMs a chain simulates tool calling.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The tools used in the Matching Agent include Hybrid Database Search, Metadata Matcher, Syntactic & Lexical & Semantic Matcher, Matching Summariser, Matching Validator, and Matching Merger
tool_count.note: Retrieval Agent: Metadata, Syntactic, Lexical, Semantic Retriever, Hybrid Database Store (5); Matching Agent: Hybrid DB Search, Metadata Matcher, Syntactic/Lexical/Semantic Matcher, Summariser, Validator, Merger (6+). Count approximate; tools split across two agents.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The tools used in the Retrieval Agent include Metadata Retriever, Syntactic & Lexical & Semantic Retriever, and Hybrid Database Store with Content Embedder
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool; outputs are alignment CSVs.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: We select the LangChain library [38]. The library pro-vides a wide range of agents. We select the tool calling agent
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned in README package list or paper.

loop_primitives.note: Only evidence is a LangChain zero-shot-react-description agent serialized in a test_function JSON file. That file may not be the main matching pipeline. The locator has no line number or commit hash because the excerpt gives neither. The main run loop is not in the excerpts; the paper's planning and validation steps (predict vs predict_no_validation outputs) suggest a fixed pipeline but are not verifiable here.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The planning module decomposes a complex task into several subtasks and defines the order of subtasks and tools to be invoked. The plan is stored in the dialogue

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: consisting of two Siamese agents for retrieval and matching, with a set of OM tools

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The memory is responsible for storing the in-formation retrieved from the Retrieval Agent (𝑅𝑠𝑡𝑜 ) and facilitating the search of the stored information by the Matching Agent

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: These tools enable LLM agents to simulate a traditional OM system, automating the entire matching process without human intervention.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Short-term memory: We use a conversational dialogue to store the original intermediate output of each operating process

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term memory: We select a hybrid database consisting of a traditional relational data-base and an advanced vector database.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Why does the Retrieval Agent have two parts `om_ontology_to_csv.py` and `om_csv_to_database.py`?  
Answer: You can simply combine these two parts together. We decompose this into two parts to make it easy to debug
state_persistence.note: Intermediate CSV/database persistence allows restarting later stages; no explicit resume API.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We employ a matching validator by ask-ing the LLM to self-check the candidate correspondences.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: For computational efficiency, we iterate the comparison from rank 1 to𝑛 and select the highest-ranked match with a "yes" answer for the matching merger.

rollback.note: No undo/rollback mechanism; tables are dropped and recreated each run.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the Matching Agent outputs “http://confOf#Chair_PC” as the best matching entity found in the target ontology
termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends when all entities processed; no step/cost caps described.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The cost evaluation will be stored in the file `cost.csv`. The cost calculation only works for API-accessed commercial LLMs.
cost_controls.note: Cost is measured, not capped; num_matches limits DB query size.

timeouts.note: LLM call timeout configurable; default timeout = None for GPT/Anthropic.

execution_isolation.note: Runs in-process on the host Python environment; no sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The alignment result will be stored in the folder `alignment/`.

network_policy.evidence_quote: You will need API keys to interact with API-accessed commercial LLMs.

permission_model.evidence_quote: automating the entire matching process without human intervention

tracing.evidence_quote: The matching log will be stored in the file `agent.log`. This file will be rewritten when you run a new task.

replayability.evidence_quote: Why do I find a slight difference for each run?
replayability.note: No replay facility; runs are non-deterministic.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `generate_conference_benchmark.py`: generate the results of OAEI Conference Track.

guardrails.evidence_quote: AI-generated content (AIGC) can contain harmful, unethical, prejudiced, or negative content (https://docs.mistral.ai/capabilities/guardrailing/). However, ontology matching tasks only check the meaning of domain-specific terminologies, and we have not observed such content being generated.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Agent-OM: Leveraging LLM Agents for Ontology Matching
target_domain.note: Domain is ontology matching / data integration, not covered by the value list.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Our system supports a wide range of LLMs, including OpenAI GPT [57], Anthropic Claude [3], Meta Llama [44], Alibaba Qwen [1], Google Gemma [26], and ChatGLM [84].

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: A production version linked to the PVLDB 2025 paper can be found in the `Releases` section.
